blocks.content: Create a program to print the greatest factor of a number besides itself using a loop.

items: Get an integer input and assign it to the number variable.
Create a for loop that runs from i = (number - 1) to i = 1 to access every element from 1 to number - 1 in reverse order.
Inside the loop, check if number is perfectly divisible by i and break the loop.
